correctness.rationale: For each odd prime p≥5, every nontrivial color rotation is transitive, while no cell admits three pairwise disjoint nonempty invariant color subsets, hence the action on the polyhedral realization is free. The published full-sphere-wedge theorem makes X simply connected, dimension d=p−3, with β=2^p−3 top spheres. Cartan–Leray with rows t=0,d yields H_i(Y;Z)=H_i(C_p;Z) for 0<i<d. The d-dimensional quotient CW gives torsion-free top H_d, with rank (2^p−p−2)/p by χ(X)/p. The mod-p Borel cohomology spectral sequence gives a multiplicative classifying map isomorphism in total degree <d; the nonzero v u^{(d−2)/2} and v²=0 plus the dimension bound give exact cup-length d/2. The direct code enumerates all cells at p=5,7, checks integer ∂²=0, mod-p and large-prime ranks, and the p=5 Smith factor 5. These are finite consistency checks, not substitutes for the all-prime proof.

The theorem provides exact full integral homology and the naturally motivated cup-length invariant, which grows unboundedly and yields a category lower bound. These integral and multiplicative invariants are not implied by the previously determined rational target character and resolve a clear gap for a uniform natural family. The group cohomology tools are classical, and no novelty is claimed for their general form.
